answer: Operator Liability Ledger. Each agent identity carries a signed cedar key binding it to a verified legal or billing entity. When collusion detection flags a cluster, enforcement debits the operator's ledger for every duplicate, freezing future registrations until settled. An attacker farming N identities pays N times the per-identity liability deposit plus a forge penalty for each disputed binding, and a sustained ember hold on the operator's account that decays only after clean behavior.
